sentences.text: In short: ARBORCONSULT AS is an established company in "bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning" based in Frogn, loss-making in 2025.

ARBORCONSULT AS is registered in the industry "Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning"; its registered activity is "Rådgivning, undervisning og utøvende tjenester innen grøntanlegg og trepleie sektoren.".
ARBORCONSULT AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2020-01-03, registered in Frogn.
It reported revenue of NOK 869,331 for 2025 and an operating loss of NOK 96,134 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of -11.1% and a strong equity ratio of 45% of total assets.

Revenue fell 19.3% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 1.08M to NOK 869,331); it was NOK 880,926 in 2023. The annual result went from a profit in 2024 to a loss in 2025 (2023: NOK 50,587, 2024: NOK 45,707, 2025: -NOK 75,055).
ARBORCONSULT AS is led by Erik Solfjeld, who is both CEO and board chair.
It has a board of 2. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2020-02-12.
